title: Super Mario Boh Boh
blurb: The Mario 'boh boh' — one of the plumber's stranger vocalisations, isolated and looped until it stopped making sense entirely. Mario has produced a lot of noises across four decades, and the internet has found comedy in most of them. This one is pure nonsense syllables from gaming's most famous voice. Boh boh.
origin: A vocal clip from the Super Mario series.
